title: Trust Program milestone tracker — SOC2 & ISO readiness, SSO/SAML, audit-logs
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Create a single source-of-truth milestone tracker for the Trust Program to coordinate SOC2 Type II readiness, initial ISO27001 gap remediation, SSO/SAML identity integrations, and standardized audit-log collection and retention. This ticket captures milestones, OKRs, owners, cross-team dependencies, and acceptance criteria to support roadmap planning across cycles and to be used in weekly Trust syncs.
milestones: M1: SOC2 scoping & control owners assigned — target 2025-09-22 — owner: Compliance (Amy Li)
M2: Audit log schema & ingestion pipeline v1 (structured JSON events, tenant ID, request_id, user_identity, model, token_counts) — target 2025-10-01 — owner: ENG Observability
M3: SSO/SAML IdP pilot with 2 customers + internal SSO (Okta) integration completed — target 2025-10-15 — owner: Platform Security
M4: Evidence collection automation for config & access control (CI checks, config snapshots) — target 2025-11-05 — owner: Infra/DevEx
M5: ISO27001 gap remediation plan approved & prioritized backlog — target 2025-11-20 — owner: Risk & Compliance
M6: SOC2 Type II readiness readiness audit pre-check (internal audit) — target 2025-12-01 — owner: Compliance
M7: Retention policy and archived logs path implemented (90/365/730 day tiers) — target 2025-12-10 — owner: Data Platform
M8: Playbook for control failure & incident evidence collection (runbook + Confluence doc) — target 2025-12-15 — owner: Security Ops
okrs: O1: Establish baseline trust controls for Q4 — KR1: 90% of SOC2 control owners assigned and acceptance criteria documented by 2025-10-01; KR2: Audit log coverage >= 95% of production routes by 2025-11-01

O2: Improve identity security and developer UX — KR1: Complete SSO/SAML internal pilot and 2 external customer pilots with success criteria by 2025-10-15; KR2: Decrease manual SSO onboarding time from 5 days to 1 day

O3: Automate evidence collection to reduce manual audit effort — KR1: Build 3 automated evidence collectors (config snapshots, access lists, deployment manifests) by 2025-11-05; KR2: Reduce average time to produce audit folder from 8 hours to 30 minutes
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Audit logs include mandatory fields (timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, user_id, action, model_version) and pass schema validation for 95% of events
AC2: SSO implementation supports SAML metadata exchange, signed assertions, and SCIM user provisioning for Okta and OneLogin
AC3: Control owners have documented test procedures and example evidence artifacts in Confluence
AC4: Retention and deletion pipeline is tested end-to-end with a documented restore path
AC5: Internal pre-audit completes with <5 high-severity gaps and remediation plans assigned
decisions: D1: Use columnar JSON event schema for audit logs to support flexible query and long-term archival
D2: Prioritize SAML v2.0 + SCIM for first-class SSO support; OIDC will be tracked as a follow-up
D3: Evidence collectors will be implemented as small services that snapshot config to a hardened S3 bucket with KMS encryption
D4: SOC2 Type II audit will be scheduled after remediation of critical and high gaps identified in internal pre-audit
tradeoffs: T1: Implementing full SCIM provisioning now increases scope but reduces long-term manual onboarding cost — short-term schedule risk vs medium-term operational savings
T2: Retaining full verbatim request bodies in audit logs aids forensics but increases storage and PII risk; decision made to token-redact and store payload references when possible
T3: Rolling out SSO to all customers simultaneously is faster for coverage but riskier; phased pilot approach chosen to limit blast radius
progress_updates: 2025-09-16: Kickoff meeting with Compliance, Security, Infra, Observability and DevEx. Agreed scope and control owners initial list.
2025-09-24: Audit log schema v0.1 PR submitted (ENG-1984). Feedback from Observability: add model_version and token_count fields.
2025-09-29: SSO vendor evaluation completed — recommended approach: support SAML + SCIM; Okta pilot slated first. Platform Security to open integration tasks.
2025-10-01: Internal gap analysis draft for ISO27001 delivered. High-risk gaps: asset inventory, formal key management, third-party risk assessment.
2025-10-03: Cross-team sync: moved retention milestone earlier; Data Platform to prototype tiered retention using lifecycle rules and Glacier for 730-day tier
stakeholders: Marta Gómez — Product Manager, Developer Experience
risks: R1: Delay in KMS integration (HSM vendor onboarding) could push ISO evidence timelines
R2: Uncovered control gaps during internal pre-audit may expand remediation scope
R3: Customer SAML IdP variability can increase integration effort per customer
R4: Storage cost for long-tail raw logs if retention policy is not tiered
next_steps: NS1: ENG to merge audit-log schema PR and deploy schema validation to staging by 2025-10-07
NS2: Platform Security to create Okta pilot checklist and schedule internal pilot by 2025-10-10
NS3: Compliance to run internal pre-audit checklist and publish gap list by 2025-10-20
NS4: Data Platform to prototype tiered retention and present cost estimates at next trust sync
NS5: PM to update OKR progress at end of cycle and prepare executive one-pager for leadership review
